WITH t AS (
  SELECT fish_date_season season, fish_date_doy doy, cls, yt, anglers
  FROM trips WHERE cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5') AND fish_date_season IN (1,2)
)
SELECT season, cls, CAST(doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
  SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS share_per_angler, COUNT(*) n
FROM t WHERE doy BETWEEN 260 AND 310
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,2,1;
